**Questions** <!-- pr-review v5.6 -->
Author: 1 question.

**For Author:**
1. **What sign-off does this change to billing, plans, credits or pricing need before it merges?** · [`part0.ts` L10-L12](https://github.com/example/repo/blob/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/src/billing/part0.ts#L10-L12)
   Billing, plans, credits or pricing are outside this review. Overdue invoices get a late fee after thirty days, on by default ([`part1.ts` L10-L12](https://github.com/example/repo/blob/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/src/billing/part1.ts#L10-L12), [`part2.ts` L10-L12](https://github.com/example/repo/blob/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/src/billing/part2.ts#L10-L12), [`part3.ts` L10-L12](https://github.com/example/repo/blob/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/src/billing/part3.ts#L10-L12)).
   A. You state in the PR description what changes for customers: a short written account puts on record what customers will see
   B. Whoever owns billing signs off, here or by linking where they already did: they know the pricing rules this touches
   C. You merge it as is: when customers see no change from it yet, for example while it is off
   **Recommended: A.** It takes you one paragraph, and it gives whoever owns billing something concrete to agree with.
